title: After a host restart, automatically settle registered in-flight launcher runs whose launcher and command owners are proven exited, and notify their recorded recipients
outcome: A host restart never leaves a REGISTERED launcher run stuck in 'running': on startup the host settles a proven-dead one as interrupted through the existing recoverRun owner, without rerunning stages, and notifies its recorded recipients once. Surviving detached work is left alone.
acceptance: Registered-run boot settlement is scoped from w-d7a2a7af0d64's original criteria 1-3 (Sol-a7bb's wording, concurred by Fable2 at 2026-11-11 01:29Z) as applied to REGISTERED runs; the exact criteria are proposed by the implementer and concurred before work starts.
